dedupe_keys.name: six years of high resolution monitoring data of 40 borehole heat exchangers

description: Elisa Heim and colleagues at RWTH Aachen publish six years of monitoring from 40 double-U borehole heat exchangers serving the E.ON Energy Research Center. Three subfields connect through underground vaults where inlet and outlet fluid temperature and volume flow are measured. Coherent records span 1 July 2018 through 30 June 2024. The November 2024 Zenodo deposit provides monthly CSV files at aligned 30-second resolution and prepared five-minute resolution, free under CC BY 4.0. Prepared temperatures use flow-weighted means and mask periods that do not represent heat exchange, such as no-flow conditions. Temperatures use Celsius and flows litres per minute. A supplementary table gives borehole locations and horizontal connecting-pipe lengths. These measurements can calibrate thermal and hydraulic simulations of ground-source heating and cooling. Masking affects operating-time comparisons, and sensor uncertainty remains unknown from the summary. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies the field; the CSV files were not opened.
